# Independent review A — Narita, Takei and Nakamura

PASS bounded semantic and selective Japanese-text/register review for all three exact V1 prose-model candidates. No material defect or narrow correction is requested. This is independent model review at the admitted person/era/domain boundaries; root still owns acceptance, canonical authority and publication. No global capability, calibration or blind prediction grade is awarded.

| Candidate | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---|
| Narita/Gumi V1 | 10,391 | `d3df13a386dd9a3d0dbfa58f04fc77197e44697334950fcfde1f891fd203f550` |
| Takei V1 | 10,390 | `51d2c37d5af36354dea694b38ef8210539c7a87bdc6cf218d2dcc2b494bb3894` |

The first pair's complete review, mechanisms, actual read scopes and12 independent challenge traces remain preserved in FIRST_PAIR_REVIEW.md and its seal. Their payloads and shared packet/preregistration are unchanged. Nakamura's complete86-line candidate and all4 producer NS traces were subsequently acquired. The other reviewer's Konno body/trace responsibility is not silently counted as reviewed here.

Nakamura's operational mechanisms are evidence-faithful: SM1 separates practice, defeat and recognition; SM2 keeps particular attachment with reassurance costs; SM3 lets roughness support hosting/friendship without charm or infidelity claims; SM4 separates friendship from specified cooperation; SM5 accepts V12 participation without filling the unshown interval; SM6 restricts the family route to attributed retrieval. Finite selectors keep opponent/friend, Yuzu care, supplemental private access, V11 refusal and V12 local participation separate. Ordinary positive ends—matches, being taken seriously, entertaining guests, shared history and birthday work—remain substantive. The model rejects both all-pride caricature and a linear redemption story.

All six independently frozen Nakamura challenges were manually applied, bringing this review to18 independent challenge traces. Their actual outputs preserve early effort/care, recipient contrast, private Yuzu access, V11 injury/partial knowledge, unshown V12 reconciliation and unsupported adulthood. Known-corpus checks knowingly use already exposed episodes; synthetic constraints have no canonical truth label. Multiple plausible bounded responses remain allowed. No numerical accuracy, hidden holdout or separate executable-persona run is claimed.

I also checked the twelve complete producer traces for the three assigned people. Inputs/selectors, evidence exposure, actual outputs, field abstentions and observed-error statements remain attributable. I found no semantic/register violation or suppressed failed attempt within the acquired evidence. A producer's statement that no error was detected is not itself the independent result; it was compared with the complete models, actual outputs and personally acquired dossiers/owner windows.

Japanese-text/register scope is selective and explicit. Current outputs describe communicative acts rather than generate Japanese dialogue. Narita's playful/slack familiar exchanges remain compatible with a small local refusal and ignorance; Takei's energetic/surname/loudness evidence retains occlusion and cannot produce Yuzu's lost sentence; Nakamura's direct/rough/joking/terse care varies by recipient and never becomes a hidden-kind-self code or fixed insult vocabulary. No new exact form, frequency-complete idiolect, independently heard acoustic profile or dialogue-imitation validation is certified. Model constraints preserve actual inward/spoken, private/actor and authored/real boundaries.

Identity checks bind all first/second slice payloads, shared dependencies and actual model/trace joins. The28 declared dependency snapshots previously replayed against their actual Git commits; all16 protected-route records equal the adopted fixed register. The dependency packet and preregistration still have their original hashes. No source escalation was needed: no concrete material contradiction requiring an additional primary scene was identified. All source-locator and prior Japanese consultation scopes remain inherited, not relabeled fresh novel or pixel reading.

Independent pre-exposure criteria remain22,434 bytes/SHA-256 `b6aec5995259c30719befd70e1613a7f0b524528b9f5e7b62815cb5fdb66ae67`. They were frozen before any producer model was opened and were not rewritten to match outputs. All18 challenge records, complete-model scopes, producer-trace scopes and no-error/no-repair findings are separate scratch evidence. Models remain nonprimary and cannot feed their new SM/TM/NM hypotheses back as literary evidence.

No canonical, Git/ref/index, source, global grade, producer output or old sealed report was modified. This review's completion does not complete the separate principal sufficiency task: Fumiya/Hinami monographs are fully acquired; Kikuchi only lines1–85; relevant principal dyad/owner windows still remain before principal findings.

# First pair independent review — immutable V1 candidates

Narita and Takei PASS independent semantic and selective Japanese-text/register review for the actual bounded prose-model candidates below. No material defect or repair is requested. Root acceptance, canonical installation and exact-head publication remain separate. Nakamura is not covered by this first-pair finding.

Narita:10,391 bytes, SHA-256 `d3df13a386dd9a3d0dbfa58f04fc77197e44697334950fcfde1f891fd203f550`. The complete80-line model preserves routine competence, money/rest/company/minimum-independence as positive ends, qualitative changing alternatives, and useful advice with a target-specific epistemic boundary. NT65 remains story-local; V12 cast identification is not a fresh behavior state. Model lines58–62 distinguish work, comparative inconvenience, advice, familiar play/disclosure cost and preference retrieval. Lines68–76 preserve local refusal, unknown stress/adult domains and non-caricatured usable conditional outputs. No numerical optimizer, secret diligence, flirt default or invented confidentiality repair appears.

Takei:10,390 bytes, SHA-256 `51d2c37d5af36354dea694b38ef8210539c7a87bdc6cf218d2dcc2b494bb3894`. The complete77-line model retains positive noticing, voluntary participation, recipient-specific warmth, educational feasibility and distinct costs. Model lines34–41 separate camp partial knowledge, captaincy, safe practice, volunteering, education, successive V11 recipients and V12 public channels. Lines55–61 give conditional mechanisms that remain usable without hidden knowledge. Lines65–75 reject fool-only/secret-mastermind caricatures, universal loyalty, fabricated given name, birth-order diagnosis and automatic consent. Loud reach and masking another speaker remain separate effects, while unfamiliar conflict/romance/adulthood are restricted.

All eight complete producer traces, including inputs/selectors, actual outputs, abstentions and error statements, were acquired. Their retrospective results are explicitly exposed and supplied; hypothetical choices carry no canonical truth label. I found no mismatch with their frozen criteria or the acquired person dossiers/owner windows. Producer observations are retained as producer observations rather than adopted as independent authority.

I separately applied all twelve frozen independent challenges for these two people. Actual model-guided outputs and field abstentions are recorded in FIRST_PAIR_INDEPENDENT_CHALLENGE_TRACES.json. The checks exercise ordinary behavior, recipient contrast, actual local refusal, concealed/private knowledge, source OPENs and new out-of-domain requests. Outputs preserve the registered constraints while returning usable in-domain alternatives. These are manual applications of a prose model, not a separate executable persona, blind forecast, measured accuracy or proof of all possible behavior.

Register scope is deliberate. The model candidates and actual traces generate no Japanese dialogue. I checked the local communicative-act controls against the complete dossiers and acquired Japanese voice/relationship distinctions: Gumi's small address refusal and relaxed peer exchanges do not imply invariant honorific/flirt rules; Takei's energetic surname introduction and narrated loudness do not imply babyish grammar, a fixed filler or measured pitch/timbre. Inward concerns stay inward; Yuzu's unheard words stay unavailable. This passes the present selective register-control scope; it does not validate new freeform Japanese wording, complete idiolect or acoustics.

All seven immutable review-slice payload identities,28 declared dependency snapshot identities and eight producer trace/model joins independently replay. All16 complete protected-route records equal the adopted fixed register. The three relevant individual released-version joins and entire unique dependency/provenance frame were acquired; other dependent bodies were not falsely relabeled freshly read. Models distinguish model hypotheses from literary evidence and make no self-supporting claim into the source corpus.

The independent preregistration remains22,434 bytes/SHA-256 `b6aec5995259c30719befd70e1613a7f0b524528b9f5e7b62815cb5fdb66ae67`, frozen before either producer candidate was opened. Its third-person Nakamura challenges remain pending actual candidate acquisition. No global capability grade, owner calibration, blind prediction, terminal closure or new primary reading is awarded. No canonical/Git/source/global/producer output was edited.
